prompts.south: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite for Veloria, a modern illustrated 2D children's adventure. Reference image is a FOUR-person atlas: use ONLY Sera in the TOP LEFT as identity and outfit reference; ignore the other three people. Generate ONE single full-body character, Sera, standing idle facing exactly SOUTH toward the viewer, symmetrical frontal body and face, both feet grounded, gentle overhead world-game perspective, not a portrait crop. Preserve her warm youthful face, brown curly hair tied loosely back, olive headband, cream short hooded jacket with moss-green sleeve bands, charcoal high-neck shirt, olive cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, olive hiking backpack centered on back with both shoulder straps. Both hands lightly hold the backpack straps. The rectangular pale-green route card hangs from HER ANATOMICAL LEFT hip (viewer RIGHT in this front view); preserve that side. Compact clean readable silhouette, warm matte painterly shading, restrained soft detail, contemporary illustrated RPG, no pixel art, no realistic 3D render. Entire single figure fits with generous transparent margin and boots fully visible; portrait 2:3 canvas. Actual transparent RGBA background. No ground, scenery, drop-shadow disk, halo, extra figures, labels, text, frames or UI. This is an independent idle pose, not a sprite sheet.
